item.title: 哥伦比亚12个月的通货膨胀比8月份预期的要多。
item.author: Reuters
item.description:
本地机器翻译 · 原文附后

BOGOTA, 9月7日(路透社) - 哥伦比亚消费价格在8月上涨了0.39%,

8月的数字高于路透社调查的分析员预测的中位数0.26%,高于7月份记录的0.17%.

年通胀率从7月的6.03%上升,

通货膨胀仍然远远高于中央银行3%加减一个百分点的目标。

每月的增长由娱乐和文化、信息和通信以及食品和非酒精饮料所带动。 服装和鞋类的价格略有下降,而教育和交通的增幅最低。

由于收入下降和支出增加,拉丁美洲第四大经济体的财政账户正在恶化。

上月上任的右翼总统阿贝拉尔多·德拉埃斯普列拉(Abelardo De La Espriella)的政府正试图从一个支离破碎的右翼组织中建立一个""自治联盟",以获得国会多数席位,左翼历史条约集团拥有最多""的席位.

(由Luis Jaime Acosta和Nelson Bocanegra报道;由Natalia Siniawski撰写;由Fabiola Aramburo编辑)

原文：Colombia 12-month inflation edges up more than expected in August

BOGOTA, Sept 7 (Reuters) - Colombia's consumer prices rose 0.39% in August, the country's DANE ‌statistics agency said on Monday, taking annual ‌price growth to 6.24%.

The August figure was above the 0.26% median forecast of analysts polled by Reuters, and higher than the 0.17% recorded in July.

Annual inflation edged up from 6.03% in July and ‌came in just ⁠above the 6.10% forcast by analysts.

Inflation remains well above the central bank's ⁠target of 3% plus or minus one percentage point.

The monthly increases were led by recreation and culture, information and communication, and food and non-alcoholic beverages. ‌Prices for clothing and footwear dipped slightly, while education and transport showed the lowest increases.

Latin America's fourth-largest economy is facing deteriorating fiscal accounts due to declining revenues and rising spending. The ‌government of right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella, who took office last month, is seeking to build a ‌governing coalition from a fragmented right-wing in order to secure a majority in Congress, where the leftist Historic Pact bloc has the largest ‌number of seats.

(Reporting by Luis Jaime Acosta and Nelson Bocanegra; Writing by Natalia Siniawski; Editing by Fabiola Aramburo)
